top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop for Third Week Straight
top_signals.summary: Oil prices fell on Friday and were set for a weekly decline on strong exports from the Middle East despite Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh and reports of tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.Brent crude futures were down 67 cents, or 0.7%, at $91.31 a barrel at 1414 GMT.

top_signals.title: SEC’s Daly on a Rapidly Evolving ETF Market
top_signals.summary: Brian Daly, Director of the Division of Investment Management at the SEC, joins Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Daly discusses the rapid evolution of the ETF market, the SEC’s approach to novel products and why the agency is taking an iterative approach rather than rewriting the rules. He also addresses prediction markets, tokenization, leverage and the resilience of the ETF market structure as the industry expands. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
